subject: PO metadata, invoice rhythm and EDI schema for billing automation
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@healthgridlabs.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@healthgridlabs.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO fields + invoice cadence question

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement is ready to move forward but we need to align on a few operational items before the PO is issued:

1) Invoicing cadence: our AP team prefers consolidated monthly invoices for SaaS spend. Is Redwood able to produce one monthly invoice per PO (showing itemized usage buckets) rather than frequent weekly invoices?

2) PO header requirements: our system requires a PO number to appear in the invoice header and an internal "billing_code" field (6 char) for ledger mapping. Please confirm which invoice header fields you can populate automatically.

3) Net terms: standard for us is Net60. Can Redwood accommodate Net60 on this engagement, or do you work only with Net45/Net30?

4) Integration: the AP team would prefer a CSV/EDI schema we can drop into our invoice ingest pipeline. If you have a sample schema, please attach.

I've attached our order_template.xlsx to show the fields our ERP expects.

Looking forward — if you need a quick call to align, procurement is available tomorrow afternoon.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Procurement
HealthGrid Labs

Attachment: order_template.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@healthgridlabs.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO fields + invoice cadence question

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear rundown and the template. Confirming receipt of order_template.xlsx. We can support the requested items but there are a few trade-offs to note:

- Invoice cadence: Yes — we can consolidate usage into a single monthly invoice per PO. That will be the default for any committed billing lanes. For ad-hoc/overage charges tied to burst or overages, we typically surface those as a separate line item on the monthly statement rather than separate invoices.

- PO header and billing_code: We can populate PO number in the invoice header and add a custom free-form field labeled "billing_code" to the invoice metadata. For automated processing we prefer a consistent JSON/CSV column name of "billing_code" (6 chars) — we'll include that in the schema.

- Net terms: Our standard is Net45. Net60 can be accommodated for enterprise customers but requires sign-off from Finance. Priyom (cc'd) can confirm the approval path and whether this needs a one-time waiver or must be added to the contract.

- EDI/CSV schema: attaching our billing_schema_v1.csv which maps our invoice export fields to common ERP columns. It includes invoice_header.po_number, invoice_header.billing_code, line_item.sku, line_item.quantity, and aggregate.

Next steps: if monthly consolidation works for you, we'll propose language in the SOW that the customer will receive one consolidated invoice per calendar month per PO with itemized usage. Vanessa, can you add tiered discount language options if they commit to an annual consumption band?

Happy to hop on a 30-min call tomorrow at 2pm PT if that helps.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Director, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: billing_schema_v1.csv (csv)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@healthgridlabs.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO fields + invoice cadence question

Hi Marta — appreciate the template and Jordan's schema. A couple of points from pricing/packaging perspective before we finalize contract language: 

1) Discounting: If HealthGrid commits to an annual committed spend band (example: $250k committed TCV) we can provide a volume discount that applies as a credit on the consolidated monthly invoices. Credits will appear as a separate line on the invoice (credit_adjustment).

2) Invoice references: to avoid AP reconciliation friction, please send us the exact field name your ERP pulls for ledger mapping. Our billing export uses "billing_code" by default but we can add an alias field, e.g., "legacy_billing_id" if that makes ingestion easier.

3) PO splitting: If you prefer a single PO but different bill-to entities (multiple business units), we can accept multiple billing_code values per PO and include an itemized breakdown per business unit on the monthly invoice. This avoids creating multiple POs.

4) Net60: Finance will consider a Net60 request for signed enterprise contracts only. Priyom — can you confirm whether we need a Finance approval ticket or if this can be routed through legal as a contract addendum?

Marta — I've added a HubSpot note to the deal (link below) with the proposed discount tiers and sample invoice lines. If you can share the ERP field name for ledger mapping and confirm the preferred test file format (CSV or EDI), we can produce a pre-billing test file next week.

Link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345/RG-2391

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@healthgridlabs.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO fields + invoice cadence question

Vanessa, Jordan — thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement confirms:

- Monthly consolidated invoices per PO: accepted.
- We'll include our PO number in the invoice header (ERP requires header field name "PO_NUM"). Please map your invoice_header.po_number -> PO_NUM.
- Our ledger mapping field is "GLBILL" (6 chars). Please include both "billing_code" and an alias column "GLBILL" in the CSV export.
- Net60: Procurement will request Net60 on the PO; please advise if Finance needs a formal approval ticket. If so, we can attach the PO to the ticket.
- EDI/CSV: CSV is our preferred staging format. Please send a pre-billing test file to procurement@healthgridlabs.com next Tuesday. We'll validate ingest and provide feedback.

We'll prepare the PO once we have the mapped CSV sample and confirmation on Net60 process. Attaching a sample of our filled order_template for reference.

Best regards,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Procurement
HealthGrid Labs

Attachment: order_template_filled.xlsx (xlsx)
